en.headline: Housing Society raises rents 2.85% from October at most rental estates
en.dek: Category A tenants will pay about HK$73 more on average each month and Category B tenants about HK$200 more; the new levels run until September 2028.
body: The Hong Kong Housing Society said its executive committee has approved a 2.85 per cent rent increase for most of its rental housing estates from 1 October 2026. The adjusted rents will remain in force until 30 September 2028.

After the rise, Category A estate tenants will on average pay about HK$73 more per month, while Category B tenants will pay about HK$200 more. Four estates that began welcoming tenants within the past two years are excluded: Yue Ying Lau in Aberdeen, Block 1 of Lok Kiu Lau at Hung Shui Kiu and Ha Tsuen, Lok Ling Lau in Fanling, and Block 1 of Hung Kok Terrace in Ngau Tau Kok.

The Society, a self-financing non-profit body, reviews rents every two years, balancing operating costs against tenants’ ability to pay. It noted that operating expenses have risen as blocks age and facilities are upgraded, producing operating losses that are expected to continue for the next two years. A Rent Assistance Programme remains available for eligible households facing temporary hardship, offering reductions of one-quarter or one-half of rent.

zh.headline: 房協出租屋邨十月起加租2.85% 甲乙類平均月租增73至200元
zh.dek: 新租金由10月1日起生效至2028年9月30日，近兩年新入伙四個屋邨不在今次檢討範圍內。
body: 香港房屋協會宣布，執行委員會已通過2026年至2028年度轄下出租屋邨的新租金安排。由今年10月1日起，大部分出租屋邨租金將上調2.85%，新水平維持至2028年9月30日。
調整後，甲類出租屋邨租戶平均每月多繳約73元，乙類租戶平均多繳約200元。近兩年新入伙的四個出租屋邨，包括香港仔漁映樓、洪水橋／厦村樂翹樓1座、粉嶺樂嶺樓及牛頭角鴻鵠臺第一座，不納入今次租金檢討。
房協作為自負盈虧的非牟利機構，每兩年檢討一次租金，會平衡營運成本與租戶負擔能力。面對屋邨老化，過去兩年優化設施令營運開支上升，帳目錄得虧損，預計未來兩年仍將持續虧損。合資格有短暫經濟困難的租戶可申請租金援助計劃，獲減免四分之一或一半租金。
